sloka: अस्थीनि मेघा ववृषुरुष्णं शोणितमेव च ।वेलां समुद्राश्चोत्क्रान्ताश्चेलुश्चाप्यथ भूधराः ।। ७.६.५४ ॥
transliteration: asthīni meghā vavṛṣuruṣṇaṁ śoṇitameva ca ।velāṁ samudrāścotkrāntāśceluścāpyatha bhūdharāḥ ।। 7.6.54 ॥

translations.english: Clouds rained bones and hot blood, oceans overflowed their shores, and mountains also trembled.
